Alder Peak Robotics Benefits Overview

Welcome to the team. This summary describes the benefits available to employees at Alder Peak Robotics.
Health insurance starts on your first day. The 401(k) plan includes a company match after thirty days.
Paid time off accrues monthly, and parental leave is twelve weeks. Open enrollment runs each November.
Equity: eligible employees receive stock options that follow a standard four-year schedule with a one-year cliff.
The exercise price is set by the board at fair market value on the grant date.
Contact people@alderpeak.example with questions about benefits.
